fill_rule.entry_bar_rule: open_time equals decision_at plus one minute
fill_rule.exit_bar_rule: open_time equals observation_end minus one minute
fill_rule.financing_reason: Every position is closed intraday at the fixed session clock.

notional.interpretation: P&L is USD per fixed one-ounce position; returns are also reported in basis points of entry notional.

spread.source: observed spread_price on the exact entry and exit one-minute bars
spread.treatment: The broker chart quote is treated as a symmetric reference quote. Half the observed entry spread is paid adversely at entry and half the observed exit spread adversely at exit.
spread.missing_policy: Exclude the case with SPREAD_UNKNOWN; never impute a default.

incomplete_session_policy.eligible_case_source: Only immutable SESSION_CASE records admitted by milestone 2.
incomplete_session_policy.entry_or_exit_bar_missing: Exclude with exact reason; do not fill forward or substitute another bar.
incomplete_session_policy.entry_or_exit_spread_missing: Exclude with exact reason; do not impute.

position_policy.same_instrument_overlap: If an earlier XAUUSD position remains open at a later candidate entry, skip the later candidate.
position_policy.session_reporting: London and New York are reported separately; no portfolio leverage or account scaling is applied.

DETERMINISTIC_RANDOM.input: namespace + ASCII vertical bar + immutable case_id
DETERMINISTIC_RANDOM.mapping: first digest byte below 128 is LONG; otherwise SHORT

metrics.uncertainty_method: Normal approximation using sample standard error; no resampling or parameter search.
metrics.return_aggregation: Arithmetic per-case returns; no compounding or account-level scaling.
